title: Routine 4-dose PCV series completed by age 2 years
action: Administer the routine 4-dose PCV series at 2, 4, 6 and 12-15 months of age

derived.min: last dose due by 15 months, so children who are 2 years old at the end of the measurement year should have completed the series
derived.max: restrict to the single birth cohort turning 2 so each child is assessed once, after the series is due

derived.window: a child aged 2 at end of MY was born no earlier than {MY-2}-01-01, so this window covers all doses from birth; it may also count doses given after the 2nd birthday but before Dec 31
